assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness.
The symptoms raise concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.

Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with the neurological symptoms and dizziness.
This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the service.
